The '''Z-95 I3 Headhunter''' was a starfighter produced by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and the [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]]. The "Improved Model 3" (I3) was one of the most popular models in the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] series and saw use on various planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
